name: Trip suitcase
summary: What a trip costs each: an open suitcase packed with the trip's costs as drawn things sized by price, and a luggage tag with the per-person number; tap a cost to take it out and watch the tag drop, then pin the number.
useWhen: 'ok but how much is this actually gonna cost' before a group trip
trip costs in the chat: 'airbnb $612, gas $160, groceries $90, the fancy dinner $240'
deciding what to cut to bring the per-person cost down
dontUseWhen: splitting costs after the trip is paid (use settle-up)
choosing where to go or when (use trip-lock or a poll)
paying back one person for gas (use gas-pump)

ask.description: The question from the chat and who asked it

quip.description: a line shown when it is taken out
